title: Demo — checker, retrieval, order form, description

state_keys.messages: the dialog, including the FunctionMessages that mark the open slot
state_keys.pizza_id: the id the Pizza API knows the pizza by
state_keys.customer_address: (city, street, house number), validated by the API
state_keys.order_id: the id of the placed order

checker.purpose: The router of the process. Decides what the utterance is: a description question, an answer to the slot the bot just asked for, or a new ordering intent — and rejects what is none of them.
checker.failure: Unknown pizza or undeliverable address -> invalid = True and a message saying so. Nothing is guessed.

retrieval.purpose: Writes the value the checker accepted into the slot the last FunctionMessage asked for — the extraction already happened in the checker.
retrieval.failure: No FunctionMessage to answer -> the state passes through unchanged.

order_form.purpose: The form itself: asks for the next missing slot, and once pizza and address are filled, places the order and returns the order id.
order_form.failure: The API refuses the order -> one honest message, dialog ends.

description.purpose: Answers a question about a pizza: context for the question from Wikidata through the Qanary pipeline, phrased by the LLM.
description.failure: No context from Qanary -> the model answers from the question alone.
